title: Instagram: Stories, Filters, and Notifications
description: Add ephemeral stories, photo filters, and real-time notifications.

data.text: Add 24-hour stories, image filter pipelines, and push notifications for likes and comments.

data.title: Story and FilterPipeline
Why stories expire?
data.text: 24-hour expiration creates urgency and reduces storage costs. Store stories in a time-partitioned store and delete expired ones with a background job.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Notifications are push-based for real-time feel
Image processing should be async and offloaded
data.takeaway: Instagram stories add ephemeral content. Filters are a pipeline pattern. Notifications make the app feel alive.
